newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP confirms exploration restructure plan.
newsitem.headline: BHP confirms exploration restructure plan.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd on Thursday confirmed media reports that it would cease preliminary exploration in six countries and close some mineral exploration offices to accelerate its more promising projects.

"Priority is being given to those prospects which have the best chance of being a major or medium-size discovery in the next five years, i.e. the larger long-life mines needed to drive BHP's growth," BHP said in an internal briefing note made available to Reuters.
BHP Minerals spokesman Tony Wells said cost savings stemming from the new exploration strategy amounted to less than A$10 million a year.
"It doesn't represent a major change in outlays. It's not a major reduction in exploration budgets," he said.
BHP spends about A$150 million a year on exploration worldwide.
